# SparkRevive

> SparkRevive helps couples rekindle their relationship through personalized experiences, meaningful conversations, AI-generated date ideas, and thoughtful activities.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of SparkRevive and its relationship-enhancement features.
- [Date Generator](/date-generator): AI-powered personalized date ideas.
- [Chemistry Lab](/chemistry-lab): Interactive scenarios to strengthen connection.
- [CloserKit](/closer-kit): Personalized intimacy-building exercises.
- [Conversation Hub](/conversation-hub): Meaningful discussion topics for couples.
- [Love Language Quiz](/love-language-quiz): Discover how you and your partner express affection.
- [Vision Quest](/vision-quest): Create and share relationship goals.
- [Valia Quiz](/valia-quiz): Explore your relationship values.
- [Community](/community): Discussion topics with other members.

## Optional

- [Progress](/progress): Track your relationship growth (requires sign-in).
- [Dashboard](/dashboard): Personalized dashboard with AI assistant (requires sign-in).
